papers.title: Fashion Retail: Forecasting Demand for New Items
papers.date_note: Only the first-public year is established in the current source record.
papers.authors: Pawan Kumar Singh; Yadunath Gupta; Nilpa Jha; Aruna Rajan
papers.horizon: Item-week and article aggregates; test series span 4-26 weeks
papers.summary: Shows a practical attribute-to-demand approach and reports retailer use; useful for a tabular baseline.
papers.recipe: Attribute/covariate regression; tested RF, GBRT, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, MLP and LSTM variants
papers.practical_fit: A tabular launch baseline using product and merchandising attributes; original sales data are private.
strengths: Shows a practical attribute-to-demand approach and reports retailer use; useful for a tabular baseline.
limitations: Private fashion data; forecast-time discount/visibility availability needs audit; no calibrated uncertainty.
papers.read_depth: Full-text methods, data split, results and deployment subsection

papers.title: Well Googled is Half Done: Multimodal Forecasting of New Fashion Product Sales with Image-based Google Trends
papers.date_note: First public date and later publication year are kept separate.
papers.authors: Geri Skenderi; Christian Joppi; Matteo Denitto; Marco Cristani

history.auxiliary_history: Google Trends attributes, not target sales

papers.target_unit: Weekly units aggregated by product across chain stores
papers.horizon: Main comparison six weeks; horizon sensitivity separately reported
papers.summary: Makes zero-history multi-week prediction explicit and supplies a reusable fashion dataset protocol.

papers.title: The Multi-Modal Universe of Fast-Fashion: The Visuelle 2.0 Benchmark
papers.date_note: First public date and later publication year are kept separate.
papers.authors: Geri Skenderi and Christian Joppi and Matteo Denitto and Berniero Scarpa and Marco Cristani
papers.history_label: First 2 weekly sales observations · 14 launch days
papers.horizon: First two weeks predict ten; rolling two-week/one-week origins need age filtering
papers.summary: Provides a direct early-launch sales-prefix protocol and richer store-level data.
papers.recipe: Cross-Attention RNN with images; naive, SES and kNN controls
papers.practical_fit: An initial two-week item-store sales benchmark; verify each product's first retailer-wide launch.
strengths: Provides a direct early-launch sales-prefix protocol and richer store-level data.
limitations: Stockout-free selection changes population; per-shop release must be reconciled to retailer-wide SKU launch. Normalized prices prevent direct dollar validation.
papers.read_depth: Primary arXiv PDF sections 1-3 and official dataset page

papers.title: Predicting demand for new products in fashion retailing using censored data
papers.date_note: Volume year 2025; DOI registered 2024. Exact first-public date is not established.
papers.authors: M. S. Sousa and A. L. D. Loureiro and V. L. Migueis
papers.target_unit: Aggregate demand for a new collection product; not a daily forecast target
papers.horizon: Product exposure period; native duration varies, not a history prefix
papers.summary: Addresses the difference between sales and demand when older training products were out of stock.
papers.recipe: Historical stockout reconstruction/EM substitution plus RF, DNN, SVR or distance-based new-product model
papers.practical_fit: Stockout-adjusted historical demand combined with new-product attributes; original data are confidential.
strengths: Addresses the difference between sales and demand when older training products were out of stock.
limitations: First sale proxies exposure; zero-stock and zero-sales rule misses partial-day stockouts. Reconstructed demand is estimated, not observed ground truth.
papers.read_depth: Publisher-indexed abstract and Sections 3-4, limitations; direct fetch blocked
